description: Molecular structure viewer and protein analysis plugin for ChiSurf; its labelling editor builds fps.json plans (Tools > Labelling), and its RPC checks plans and fetches structures headlessly.

rpc_methods.name: chimol.fps.validate
rpc_methods.summary: Check an fps.json payload's sections and references; errors, warnings and a summary.

payload.description: An fps.json document: Positions, Distances, optional χ² score sets and extra sections.

result_schema.description: Service envelope: ok, result or error.

rpc_methods.name: chimol.fps.summarize
rpc_methods.summary: Summarize positions, distances, score sets and unresolved references of an fps.json payload.

payload.description: An fps.json document: Positions, Distances, optional χ² score sets and extra sections.

result_schema.description: Service envelope: ok, result or error.

rpc_methods.name: chimol.fps.normalize
rpc_methods.summary: Return an fps.json payload in canonical form.

payload.description: An fps.json document: Positions, Distances, optional χ² score sets and extra sections.

result_schema.description: Service envelope: ok, result or error.

rpc_methods.name: chimol.pdb.fetch
rpc_methods.summary: Download a structure from RCSB by its four-character PDB ID.

output_dir.description: Where to write; the structure cache when omitted.

result_schema.description: Service envelope: ok, result or error.

rpc_methods.name: chimol.av.mrc.save
rpc_methods.summary: Write accessible-volume points as an MRC density map.

path.description: Output file; .mrc is appended unless present.

points.description: (N, 3) xyz or (N, 4) xyz plus weight, in Å.

result_schema.description: Service envelope: ok, result or error.
